title: Clarify first
text: The interviewer asks a long question and one phrase is unclear.

options.text: Yes, of course. It is very important.
options.response: 泛化回应没有回答问题，也没有修复理解上的空缺。

options.text: Sorry, my English is not good.
options.response: 可以坦诚，但给出具体澄清请求会让交流继续。

options.text: Could you clarify what you mean by external validity in this case? I want to make sure I address the right issue.
options.response: 确认含义后再回答，通常比猜测问题更有效。
